# UI FOR QUESTS CHEAT SHEET:
## Abrivations:
1. (g) any playable character can complete this quest if they do or have done the criteria
2. (p) when you have completed this subquest you may now switch to and play hense the (p) as that character
3. (name) this quest action must be done or have been done by that character name in order to complete
4. (complete) this quest is now completed and will go into counting as so for victors final quest
# How Quests work: 
## Each quest follows a paritcular order. Every quest item starts as active at 1 and for each item you complete you move down to the next quest item.
## certain quest items can only be completed or needs to have been completed in the past by a certain character.
### This means for example if an action item already has been done it'll auto complete teh quest just as long as the character required to do that thing has done so

# QUESTS
## Austine
1. Talk to Austine (g)
2. Ask to switch to Austine (g)
3. obtain necesary item(tyson)
4. Give to austine(tyson)(p)
5. obtain information (map) on queen's location (austine) (complete)
## Isabela
1. Talk to Isabela (g)
2. Ask to switch to Isabela (g) 
3. Talk to all characters (g)(p) (7 out of 7 as character your playing as)
4. obtain a zillian zillium (isabela) 
5. Upgrade weapon (isabela) (complete)
## Alexis
1. Talk to Alexis (g) 
2. Ask to switch to Alexis (g)

4. obtain more weapons (6 out of 6)(alexis)
5. Defeat 1 boss (dd, ss, hb, or cb) (alexis) (complete)
## Nicholas
1. Talk to Nicholas (g)
2. Ask to switch to Nicholas (g) 
3. Win target mini game (g)(p) 
4. Find lost guide book(nicholas) 
5. Give to Austine (nicholas) (complete)
## Tyson
1. Talk to Tyson (g)
2. Ask opal to switch to Tyson (opal)
3. Have opal quests all complete (opal)

## Chloe

2. Ask to switch to Chloe (g)

2. Ask to switch to Victor (g)

5. (bonus) Return to skia (victor)
